parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan assembly consisting of blades and a central hub, typically made of aluminum for lightweight and durability.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air, providing cooling and ventilation in a room.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting rod of the ceiling fan, usually made of steel for structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan assembly and connects it to the ceiling, ensuring stability and proper alignment.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary and does not move during fan operation.
